spec.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
import "array"
import "join"

// Set the global location context
option location = timezone.location(name: "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")

ytd_start = date.sub(from: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d), d: 1d)
ytd_stop = date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1d)

last_start = date.sub(from: ytd_start, d: 7d)
last_stop = date.sub(from: ytd_stop, d: 7d)

ytd_data = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: ytd_start, stop: ytd_stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "loadUsage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> sum()


last_data = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: last_start, stop: last_stop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "loadUsage")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> sum()


default = array.from(rows: [
    {_value: 0.0, "_field": "loadUsage"},
  ])

ytd = union(tables: [ytd_data, default])
  |> group()
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "yesterday"})
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with join_key: 1 })) 

lastWk = union(tables: [last_data, default])
  |> group()
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "lastWeek"})  
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with join_key: 1 })) 

join.inner(
    left: ytd,
    right: lastWk,
    on: (l, r) => l.join_key == r.join_key,
    as: (l, r) => ({
      yesterday: l.yesterday,
      lastWeek: r.lastWeek,
      diff: if r.lastWeek > 0.0 then (r.lastWeek - l.yesterday) / r.lastWeek else 0.0
    }),
)

spec.title: RTH Yesterday vs Same Day Last Week

spec.query:
power = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "main")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "totalPower")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "power"}))

load = from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "chwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyFlowRate")
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "coolingLoad", _value: r._value * 78.986}))

union(tables: [power, load])
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["coolingLoad", "power"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with efficiency: if r.coolingLoad > 0.0 then r.power / r.coolingLoad else 0.0 }))

from(bucket: "cpms")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "flow")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["category"] == "chiller")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["deviceId"] == "cwHeader")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "energyFlowRate")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with coolingLoad: r._value * 78.986}))
  |> drop(columns: ["_value"])
